# Morphic Solutions

> Morphic Solutions is an AI-native build studio in Amsterdam for companies that make, move, and sell physical things: manufacturing, trade, and logistics. It builds AI agents, a Company Brain that makes company knowledge legible to AI, and self-improving AI loops that fix themselves overnight. Builders, not advisors. Founded in 2024 by Jop Welten.

## What Morphic builds

- AI Agents: software workers that handle repetitive, rules-based tasks end to end, so people focus on judgment work.
- Company Brain: a structured knowledge layer that makes a company's documents, data, and decisions legible to AI; the durable asset that compounds.
- Self-Improving Loops: AI systems built on the cycle sensor → policy → tools → quality gate → learning; they measure their own output and write their own fix overnight.
- The Edge: the operating model. Loops run the work; humans stay at the edge where judgment, ethics, and the genuinely new matter. One DRI on every loop and dataset.

## Who it's for

- Manufacturers, traders, and logistics operators: businesses where the work is physical and much of the day still runs on manual steps a machine could do better.

## How Morphic works

- Builders, not advisors: no slide decks; embedded teams that learn how the operation actually runs and ship software the team uses daily.
- Short cycles with visible progress; working software early and often.
- Measurable: outcomes defined up front and tracked (tasks automated, time saved, errors reduced).
- "We don't just advise. We build the loops that run your company." / "Burn tokens, not headcount."
